reason: The simulator completed autonomously, but the preregistered filesystem-wide disk delta gate observed 8123228160 bytes, above 512 MiB. Concurrent unrelated archive writes under /home/yu/rongyao_staging occurred during the same interval, so the delta cannot be attributed to this experiment. The independent finalizer was intentionally not run.

search_best.interpretation: The search found local cruise/deceleration improvements in a 16-environment candidate cell, but every winning candidate terminated all 16 environments during hold. The selected high-dimensional matrix failed to generalize to the 256-environment validation.

diagnostic_only_observations.interpretation: The direct locomotion-to-stationary handoff is the dominant reproducible failure. A fixed open-loop correction improves cruise pitch locally but does not survive the transition. This particular direct 15x17 CEM teacher overfits and is not a deployable or trainable teacher. These are exploratory observations from a resource-invalid run and cannot promote any model.

next_route.name: isolated_brake_and_handoff_feasibility
next_route.scope: Separate transition scheduling and hold acquisition from posture correction. Compare zero-command locomotion, current direct handoff, speed/contact-gated blends, and stationary backends without any posture residual or training.
